entries.jp:
龍馬たちが歌い終わると
役目を果たしたとばかりに
超魂はその輝きを薄れさせ
また五つの欠片に戻った
entries.en:
As Ryoma and the
others finished
singing, the Ultra
Soul's glow faded
as if its work
were done, and it
split back into
five pieces.

entries.jp: そして　それぞれの内へと\n吸い込まれていく\n光は静かに消えていった
entries.en:
Each was drawn
back inside its
owner, and the
light quietly
faded away.

entries.jp: くっ……
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.jp: 井伊……\nわしにはわかったぜよ\nお前の気持ちが
entries.en: Ii... I get it now.\nHow you feel.

entries.jp: ぐ……うぐ……\nなにがわかったと……\nいうのだ……
entries.en:
Gh... ugh... And
what... is it you
think you
understand...?

entries.jp: お前がどうして\nそこまでして\n天歌を歌うのか
entries.en: Why you'd go\nso far to sing\nHeaven's Song.

entries.jp: 大切な人のために\nその人を守るために\n平和な世を作りたかった
entries.en:
For someone
precious to you.
To protect that
person, you
wanted to build
a peaceful world.

entries.jp: そういう気持ちが\n魂の叫びが聞こえたぜよ
entries.en:
I heard that
feeling, the
cry of your
soul, I tell ya.

entries.jp: ……くっ　貴様に　何が\nぐふっ……
entries.en: ...Ngh... What\ncould you\npossibly... Gwhh...

entries.jp: もう　やめにしよう\n魂を食われてしまう
entries.en: Let's stop this\nnow. Your soul's\ngonna get eaten.

entries.jp: ならん……\n慶喜様のために\n我は……まだ……
entries.en:
I cannot... For
Yoshinobu-sama's
sake... I
must... still...

entries.jp: 井伊！\nしっかりしろ！
entries.en: Ii! Hang in there!

entries.jp: 聞け　坂本\n貴様の言う泰平の世は\n決して実現しない……
entries.en:
Listen, Sakamoto.
The peaceful
world you speak
of will never
come to pass...

entries.jp: なんだって？
entries.en: What!?

entries.jp: 貴様達のような\n強い魂を持つ者は\nいいだろう
entries.en:
For those with
strong souls
like yours, it
may be fine.

entries.jp: しかし　人はそれほど\n強くはないのだ……
entries.en: But people are\nnot so strong...

entries.jp: 努力が徒労に終わった時\n人は絶望の淵に落ちる
entries.en:
When their
efforts come to
nothing, people
fall into the
abyss of despair.

entries.jp: 自分の弱さを忘れ\n他人の強さを妬み\n自分より弱い者を蔑む
entries.en:
They forget
their own
weakness, envy
the strength of
others, and scorn
those weaker
than themselves.

entries.jp: それが争いを生んできた\n古来より　ずっと\nその繰り返しだ……
entries.en:
That is what has
bred conflict.
Since ancient
times, it has been
the same cycle,
over and over...

entries.jp: 井伊\nお前は……
entries.en: Ii... you...

entries.jp: 坂本龍馬よ\nこれは我が遺す呪詛だ\n努々　忘れるなよ
entries.en:
Ryoma Sakamoto...
this is the curse I
leave you. Never,
ever forget it.

entries.jp: そんなことはない！\n人間というのは\nもっと　もっと――
entries.en:
That ain't true!
People are so
much... so
much more--

entries.jp: それが……\n小賢しいというのだ……\nぐふっ
entries.en:
That... is
exactly what I
call impudent...
Gwhh...

entries.jp: 死ぬな！\n井伊
entries.en: Don't die! Ii!

entries.jp: 我は　ただ……
entries.en: I only...

entries.jp: ただ慶喜様のために――\nあの方が穏やかに暮らせる\n世の中にしたかった
entries.en:
Only for
Yoshinobu-sama--
I wanted a world
where he could
live in peace.

entries.jp: あの方はお優しい\nだが　強くはない
entries.en: He is kind. But\nhe is not strong.

entries.jp: それだけが\n心残りだ――
entries.en: That alone... is\nmy one regret--

entries.jp: おい　井伊！\n目を開けろ！\n井伊
entries.en: Hey, Ii! Open\nyour eyes! Ii!

entries.jp: よせ　坂本\nもう事切れている
entries.en: Stop, Sakamoto.\nHe's already gone.

entries.jp: 井伊っ\n井伊！
entries.en: Ii--!

entries.jp: 龍馬\n終わったんだ
entries.en: Ryoma. It's over.

entries.jp: 井伊は……\n悪い奴じゃなかった
entries.en: Ii... wasn't\na bad guy.

entries.jp: 無垢すぎて　純粋すぎて\n大切な人への想いが\n強すぎて……
entries.en:
He was too
innocent, too
pure, his feelings
for the one he
cared about too
strong...

entries.jp: やり方を間違えただけ\nなんじゃ
entries.en:
He just went
about it the
wrong way,
that's all.

entries.jp: もっと早く　わかり合う\nことができたら……
entries.en:
If only we
could've
understood each
other sooner...

entries.jp: 龍馬……
entries.en: Ryoma...

entries.jp: 僕も残念だよ……
entries.en: I feel the same...

entries.jp: 純粋な想いが　こんな……\nこんな哀しい結末だなんて
entries.en:
Such pure
feelings... and
such a sad,
sad ending...

entries.jp: 坂本\n悲しんでいるヒマはない
entries.en: Sakamoto. There's\nno time to grieve.

entries.jp: どういうことじゃ？\n井伊は　もう戻らないんじゃ\nヒジゾーさん！
entries.en: What d'ya mean?\nIi ain't ever comin'\nback, Hijizo-san!

entries.jp: 井伊の魂を食らった者……\nそいつが真の悪って\nことにならないか？
entries.en:
Whoever
devoured Ii's
soul... Wouldn't
that make them
the true evil?

entries.jp: 真の……悪？
entries.en: The true... evil?

entries.jp: 俺は坂本が歌っている時に\n井伊から妙な気配を感じた
entries.en:
While you were
singing,
Sakamoto, I
sensed something
strange coming
from Ii.

entries.jp: 井伊の気持ちが徳川慶喜へ\n真っ直ぐに向いていたのは\n間違いない
entries.en:
There's no doubt
Ii's feelings were
aimed straight
at Yoshinobu
Tokugawa.

entries.jp: それは　わしも感じたが……\nヒジゾーさんは　何か\n気付いたのか？
entries.en:
I felt that too,
but... Did ya
notice somethin',
Hijizo-san?

entries.jp: ハッキリとは\nしないんだが……
entries.en: I can't say\nfor sure...

entries.jp: しかし\n腑に落ちないことはある\n井伊の死に方だ
entries.en:
But there's
something that
doesn't sit right.
The way Ii died.

entries.jp: 死に方？
entries.en: The way he died?

entries.jp: 総司が死にかけた時を\n思い出せ
entries.en: Remember when\nSoji nearly died.

entries.jp: 俺はてっきり\n総司は井伊に魂を食われて\nいるんだと考えていた
entries.en: I was certain Ii\nwas the one\neating Soji's soul.

entries.jp: そりゃあ　そうじゃろう\nソウちんは井伊に操られて\nいたんだから
entries.en:
Well, sure he
was. So-chin was
bein' controlled
by Ii, after all.

entries.jp: じゃあ井伊は　いったい\n何に魂を食われたんだ？
entries.en: Then what\nexactly was\neating Ii's soul?

entries.jp: 井伊は　徳川慶喜の\nために　天歌を使って\n泰平化しようとしていた
entries.en:
Ii was trying to
pacify everyone
with Heaven's
Song for
Yoshinobu
Tokugawa's sake.

entries.jp: その井伊が　徳川慶喜が\n生きている内に自滅する\nような手段を取るかな
entries.en:
Would Ii really
choose a way that
destroys himself
while Yoshinobu
Tokugawa still
lives?

entries.jp: 僕だったら　土方さんが\n生きてるなら　地を這って\nでも逃げ延びるね
entries.en:
If it were me, as
long as
Hijikata-san was
alive, I'd survive
even if I had to
crawl through
the dirt.

entries.jp: 僕が死んじゃったら\n土方さんの世話をする人が\nいなくなっちゃうもの
entries.en:
If I died, there'd
be nobody left
to look after
Hijikata-san.

entries.jp: おい総司……\nいや　俺が言いたいのも\nまさにそこだ
entries.en: Hey, Soji... No,\nactually, that's\nexactly my point.

entries.jp: 井伊の気持ちを利用した\n何者かがいるってことか？
entries.en: You're saying\nsomeone used\nIi's feelings?

entries.jp: そいつが……\n井伊の魂を……？
entries.en: And that\nsomeone...\nate Ii's soul...?

entries.jp: ああ\n恐らくは
entries.en: Yes. Most likely.

entries.jp: 誰じゃ！\nこんな酷いことをしたのは\n誰なんじゃ！
entries.en:
Who!? Who
did somethin'
so cruel!?
Who was it!?

entries.jp: わからんのは　そこだ\n井伊は　事実上　幕府の\n最高権力者だった
entries.en:
That's what I
can't figure out.
Ii was effectively
the most
powerful man in
the shogunate.

entries.jp: そんなヤツを\n誰が利用できる
entries.en: Who could\npossibly use a\nman like that?

entries.jp: できるとすれば\n将軍　徳川慶喜だが
entries.en:
If anyone could,
it'd be the
shogun,
Yoshinobu
Tokugawa, but...

entries.jp: 死に際の井伊の口ぶりじゃ\n将軍が黒幕ってことも\nなさそうだけど……
entries.en:
From the way Ii
talked as he died,
it doesn't seem
like the shogun's
the mastermind
either...

entries.jp: いずれにせよ\n徳川家に関わりのある\n者の仕業だろう
entries.en:
Either way, it
must be the work
of someone tied
to the Tokugawa
family.

entries.jp: 徳川家の闇の部分\nというわけですね
entries.en: The dark side of\nthe Tokugawa\nfamily, you mean.

entries.jp: 井伊の想いを踏みにじり\n死なせたのは徳川家か……
entries.en:
So it was the
Tokugawa family
that trampled Ii's
feelings and let
him die...

entries.jp: それが本当なら……
entries.en: If that's true...

entries.jp: 許されることじゃねえ
entries.en: It's unforgivable.

entries.jp: 私達が\n許したとしても……
entries.en: Even if we were\nto forgive it...

entries.jp: 天が許さないよ
entries.en: ...Heaven won't.

entries.jp: 坂本\nどうする？
entries.en: Sakamoto.\nWhat'll you do?

entries.jp: 出来ることなら\nたしかめたいぜよ
entries.en: If I can, I wanna\nfind out for sure.

entries.jp: たしかめて\nどうするんだ？\n相手は将軍家だ
entries.en:
And once you
find out, then
what? We're
talking about the
shogun's family.

entries.jp: 将軍家だろうと\nなんだろうと\n関係無いぜよ！
entries.en: Shogun's family\nor whatever, it\ndon't matter!

entries.jp: こんな酷いことは\n二度としないように\n説得する！
entries.en:
I'll talk 'em into
never doin'
anything this
cruel again!

entries.jp: は？\n説得で済ますつもりかよ\nとことん呑気な野郎だ
entries.en:
Huh? You think
talking will
settle it? You're
one carefree
idiot, I swear.

entries.jp: そういうところは\n龍馬くんらしいけど
entries.en: That's so like\nyou, though,\nRyoma-kun.

entries.jp: やる価値はあるでしょ\n土方さん
entries.en: It's worth a\nshot, right,\nHijikata-san?

entries.jp: ああ\n二条城へ乗り込むぞ\n覚悟はいいな
entries.en:
Yes. We're
storming Nijo
Castle. Are
you ready?

entries.jp: 土方の問いに\n全員がうなづく
entries.en: At Hijikata's\nquestion,\neveryone nodded.

entries.jp: 行こう\n龍馬くん
entries.en: Let's go,\nRyoma-kun.

entries.jp: ああ……わかった\n井伊よ　安らかにな……\nぐすっ
entries.en: Yeah... all right.\nRest in peace,\nIi... *sniff*

entries.jp:
井伊の亡骸に
手を合わせると
龍馬達は天歌祭の
会場を抜け出した
entries.en:
After pressing
their hands
together before
Ii's body, Ryoma
and the others
slipped out of the
Heaven's Song
Festival venue.

entries.jp: 江戸の街は\n不気味なほどに\n静まりかえっていた
entries.en: The streets\nof Edo were\neerily quiet.

entries.jp: 龍馬は涙を拭いながら\n何度も振り返り\nやがて走り出したのだった
entries.en:
Wiping his tears,
Ryoma looked
back again and
again, and at last
broke into a run.
